name: Radarr
description: PVR for movies: automatically grabs, renames and sorts new releases from usenet/torrents, with quality profiles and custom formats.
compose:
services:
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:7878"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
      - /movies:/movies
      - /downloads:/downloads
    restart: unless-stopped
